About me

I’m David, a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at Geeta University, now in my 5th semester. I started in engineering with a diploma in electrical engineering and moved into computer science from there.

I enjoy problem solving and data structures and algorithms, and I’m learning full stack development with JavaScript, React and Node.js. I build independent projects, like my Study Hub platform, so I can practise on real problems instead of only reading about them.

I use AI tools as a learning aid alongside my own practice. I’m looking for internship and entry level software development roles where I can keep learning and build real-world software.
